{{Quote|Yes, my Lord. As you command, my Lord.|The Neimoidian Sith to Antares Draco|<ref name="legacy49" />}}
A member of [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[One Sith]], a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] '''Sith''' stood guard before [[XoXaan's Temple]]'s [[Chambers of Persuasion]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. When [[Imperial Knight]] [[Antares Draco]], posing as a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], ordered him to take the "prisoners" [[Shado Vao]] and [[Ganner Krieg]] to the main Inquisition Chamber, the Neimoidian answered that it was already being used by [[Darth Havok]] to interrogate [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Marasiah Fel]]. Draco then intimidated the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] into preparing another chamber. The Neimoidian then led Draco into the premises.<ref name="legacy49" />
